name: Sort it out
description: Sort the pictures into the right category. At higher levels the rule changes (category ↔ size): trains semantic memory and cognitive flexibility.
instructions:
A picture will appear with its name.
Tap the right box at the bottom, or use the keys 1, 2, 3, 4.
If you see the sign at the top, follow its rule: sometimes you sort by CATEGORY, sometimes by SIZE.
instructionsKids: Help me tidy up! Put every picture in its own little house. 🏠
